name.en: HG 1/144 Zaku II C type/C-5 type

series.ja: 機動戦士ガンダム THE ORIGIN

description.ja: • 『機動戦士ガンダム THE ORIGIN 激突 ルウム会戦』に登場するザクIIが最新フォーマットでHG化！
description.en: • The Zaku II that appears in "Mobile Suit Gundam THE ORIGIN Clash at Loum" has been made into HG in the latest format!

description.ja: • C型、C-5型が選択式で組立可能となっており、C-5型は形状の違う胸部中央と左右ブロックが新規造形！
description.en: • C type and C-5 type can be assembled selectively, and the C-5 type has a new model with a different shaped chest center and left and right blocks!

description.ja: • 兵装オプションとして、腕部のガトリングと、形状の異なるバックパックも付属する。
description.en: - Gatling arms and backpacks with different shapes are also included as optional weapons.

description.ja: • 背部にはベルト給弾式MS用マシンガンのマガジンを装備可能なほか、MS用バズーカ、対艦ライフルなど豊富な武装も付属！
description.en: • In addition to being able to equip the back with a magazine for a belt-fed MS machine gun, it also comes with a wealth of armaments such as an MS bazooka and anti-ship rifle!

accessories.ja: ベルト給弾式MS用マシンガン×1
ヒート・ホーク×2（展開・収納）

accessories.en: Bazooka A2 type for MS x 1
